card.name: Mixed word-ending spots in labels
card.fires_on: Fires on the last or middle piece of a word just before a predictable continuation in drug-label text, such as 'wound healing', 'strep-tococcal' or 'no less than'. It is spread over several unrelated word types.

modes.description: Partway through a longer medical term such as streptococcal, pharyngitis or somatropin.
